title: The Six Steps That Transform Any Space
subtitle: One slow walk around the whole loop, from the first decision to the last habit, on a single small cabinet under a sink.
audience: Readers who now know what 6S is and want to see it work. Busy home keepers and parents ready for a first hands-on lap. New to applying the method.
core_promise: Watch the entire 6S loop walk through one real space, end to end, so you feel how each step hands off to the next, then take a fifteen-minute first lap of your own.
emotional_purpose: Confidence and momentum. Turn six understood words into a method the reader can feel in their own hands, and reward starting over perfection.
practical_purpose: Demonstrate Sort, Straighten, Shine, Safety, Standardize, and Sustain in order on the under-sink cabinet, show the handoffs between steps, and assign a fifteen-minute first lap.
primary_cta: Take your first lap: set a fifteen-minute timer on one small space and walk all six steps once. Read the chapter free in the online book.
secondary_cta: Read the chapter free online, then continue to Chapter 4 to choose a target worth winning.
keywords: Sort Straighten Shine Safety Standardize Sustain

step_handoffs.Sustain: keeps alive, then back to Sort

loop_in_one_line: Sort makes room. Straighten gives things a home. Shine reveals the truth. Safety protects the people. Standardize makes the good way the easy way. Sustain keeps it alive. Then it goes around again.
one_idea_to_keep: Each step makes the next one possible. That is why 6S is an order, not a menu. You do not pick your favorite three. You walk the loop, and the loop does the work.
